text:
Hi, I’m Noor Halden, and I bring 6 years of experience in machine learning and Python-based development. I’m interested in your YouTube video editing role and can contribute a detail-oriented, story-driven approach to content creation.

While my background is primarily in ML and data workflows, I’m comfortable working with structured content, fast iteration, and tools that support AI-assisted production. I also understand the importance of keeping videos engaging, consistent with brand guidelines, and optimized for social platforms like YouTube, Instagram, Facebook, and Twitter.

One project that reflects my ability to turn complex material into something practical and usable was Telecom churn prediction. I built a monthly churn score for 380k subscribers with per-customer SHAP reasons that the retention team could read. The model achieved an AUC of 0.84 on a held-out quarter and delivered a top-decile lift of 3.1x. That project required careful attention to clarity, audience needs, and consistent output under real business constraints.

My core technical background includes Python, PyTorch, scikit-learn, LangChain, OpenAI API, Hugging Face Transformers, NLP, XGBoost, pandas, and machine learning. If your workflow includes AI-powered video generation or AI-assisted editing support, I can adapt quickly and help with structured, efficient production. I also understand the value of collaboration, clear communication, and maintaining a consistent tone across content.

I’d be glad to share relevant work and discuss how I can support your channel’s editing needs, whether that means shaping raw footage, improving pacing and clarity, or helping produce social-ready cuts that match your style.

What kind of video format are you editing most often right now: talking-head YouTube content, short-form social clips, or a mix of both?
